rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable evidence-supported optimizations. Concurrency with cancel-in-progress (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) cancels superseded/in-progress runs on the same branch or PR. Dependency caching is present via setup-java cache:maven plus the license-headers-cache restore/save steps (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). A custom job timeout of 30 minutes is already set (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), and ci_history shows successful runs complete in about 2 minutes, so the existing budget already provides operational headroom without risking runaway consumption. The remaining patterns do not fit: there is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT), no schedule trigger (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), no Bazel build (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), and path filtering or step skipping would risk the license-header coverage contract since shared configuration can affect unrelated files. No additional supported optimization fits without weakening coverage.
